grammar.summary: 本课讲玛丽的小白羊被偷又染黑还回的悬疑故事，集中运用了过去完成时的被动式（had been stolen, had been dyed, had been washed）、由 which 引导的非限制性定语从句，以及 ashamed of... 等过去分词/形容词短语作状语。句中还出现 had better 表示劝告。

points.title: 过去完成时的被动语态 (Past Perfect Passive)
points.explanation: had been + 过去分词表示「在过去某动作之前已被完成的动作」，且主语是承受者。本课「绳子被割」先于「发现失踪」，「羊毛被染黑」先于「被雨冲净」，均用过去完成被动，凸显事件的先后与真相。

examples.en: The rope had been cut, so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.
examples.cn: 绳子被人割断，很明显小羔羊是被人偷走了。

examples.en: Its wool, which had been dyed black, had been washed clean by the rain!
examples.cn: 原来羊毛上染的黑色被雨水冲掉了！

points.title: 非限制性定语从句 (Non-defining Relative Clauses)
points.explanation: which 引导非限制性定语从句，前后用逗号隔开，对先行词作补充说明而非限定。本课用 which 修饰 a little white lamb（丈夫送的礼物）和 Its wool（被染黑的羊毛），补充关键背景信息。

examples.en: One of Mary's prize possessions was a little white lamb which her husband had given her.
examples.cn: 玛丽最珍贵的财产之一就是丈夫送给她的一只白色小羔羊。

examples.en: Its wool, which had been dyed black, had been washed clean by the rain!
examples.cn: 原来羊毛上染的黑色被雨水冲掉了！

points.title: 过去分词/形容词短语作状语 (Participle/Adjective as Adverbial)
points.explanation: ashamed of having acted so rashly 中 ashamed of... 是形容词短语作状语，表示主语 Dimitri 当时的心情，相当于「因为感到羞愧，他向对方道歉」。of 后接动名词完成式 having acted，表示该动作先于道歉。

examples.en: Ashamed of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.
examples.cn: 迪米特里为自己的鲁莽而感到不好意思，向阿列科道了歉，说是错怪了他。

exercises.q: The rope ______ cut, so it was obvious that the lamb had been stolen.（过去完成被动）
One of Mary's prize possessions was a little white lamb ______ her husband had given her.
Its wool, ______ had been dyed black, had been washed clean by the rain!（非限制性定语从句）
用形容词短语作状语填空：______ of having acted so rashly, Dimitri apologized to Aleko for having accused him.（写出表示「感到羞愧」的形容词，首字母大写）
He told him he had ______ return it or he would call the police.（had better 表劝告）
